map.根据月经周期阶段评估子宫内膜厚度，辅助判断内膜容受性与病变: Assess endometrial thickness by menstrual phase to aid evaluation of receptivity and lesions

map.按周期日数分期：月经期 2–5 mm、增殖期 4–12 mm、分泌期 10–14: Stage by cycle day: menstrual 2-5 mm, proliferative 4-12 mm, secretory 10-14 mm
map.以各期参考范围评估内膜偏薄/正常/偏厚；绝经后内膜 ≤ 4–5 mm 多为萎缩性: Grade thin/normal/thick by each phase's range; postmenopausal endometrium <=4-5 mm is mostly atrophic.
map.月经周期第几天 (D1=月经第1天): Cycle day (D1 = first day of menstruation)
map.必须宫腔镜+诊刮排除内膜癌: Hysteroscopy + dilation and curettage required to exclude endometrial cancer
map.注：绝经后内膜厚度>4–5mm(尤其伴出血)需排除子宫内膜癌。绝经年限越长，萎缩: Note: postmenopausal endometrium >4-5 mm (especially with bleeding) needs to exclude endometrial cancer. Longer menopause favors atrophic endometrium.
map.排卵后D6–10天(周期D20–24)，内膜\"容受期\": 6-10 days after ovulation (cycle D20-24), the "receptive phase"
map.移植日内膜≥7–8mm(最佳8–14mm)，<7mm为薄型内膜: >=7-8 mm on transfer day (best 8-14 mm); <7 mm is thin endometrium
map.增殖晚期典型征象，提示内膜发育良好: Typical late-proliferative sign, indicates good endometrial development
map.反复<7mm，可能与宫腔粘连、感染、血流差有关: Repeatedly <7 mm, possibly linked to adhesions, infection, poor blood flow
map.提示：子宫内膜厚度随月经周期动态变化，需结合周期天数评估。绝经后阴道出血+内膜增: Tip: endometrial thickness changes dynamically with the cycle and needs phase-based assessment. Postmenopausal bleeding + thickening warrants high vigilance for endometrial cancer. For ultrasound reference only.

map.按周期天数解释内膜厚度是否正常。: Explain whether thickness is normal by cycle day.
map.备孕/移植前评估内膜是否达着床标准（≥7–8mm）。: Before conception/transfer, assess if endometrium reaches the implantation standard (>=7-8 mm).
map.排查薄型内膜与宫腔粘连。: Screen for thin endometrium and intrauterine adhesions.

map.周期第 18 天、内膜 5mm：分泌期参考 10–14mm，明显偏薄（<7mm: Day 18, thickness 5 mm: secretory ref 10-14 mm, clearly thin (<7 mm), poor implantation conditions; assess blood flow and cavity.
map.移植要求内膜多厚？: How thick must endometrium be for transfer?
map.一般 ≥7–8mm、形态 A 型（三线征）较理想；<7mm 着床率下降，可用药或: Generally >=7-8 mm and type-A (triple-line) is ideal; <7 mm lowers implantation; drugs or blood-flow improvement help, but thickness is not the only factor.
map.月经期薄正常吗？: Is thin endometrium normal during menses?
map.正常，月经期 2–5mm，随卵泡期雌激素升高而增厚，到排卵期达 8–12mm 属: Yes—2-5 mm in menses, thickening with follicular estrogen, reaching 8-12 mm at ovulation is physiological.
